_comment: Golden cases for the MCP wire protocol — the CROSS-REPO contract.
Two servers answer MCP: visivo's at visivo/server/views/mcp_views.py, and
core's at api/apps/mcp/. They share visivo.agent.mcp_protocol, so most of
what they send is the same objects rather than two implementations — but
the transports are separate code, and a transport can drop a field, change
a status code, or turn a tool refusal into a protocol error without either
This file is what keeps them honest. visivo asserts its endpoint against
it in tests/contracts/test_mcp_parity_contract.py; core asserts its own
against the same file. A case added here must pass on both sides.
Each case: `request` is the JSON-RPC body to POST. `expect` says what must
`is_error`, or `text_contains`. Shapes, not values: the cases must not
depend on which project is loaded, because the two sides load different

cases.name: the protocol version is the one both sides agree on
the server identifies itself as visivo
the instructions say writes are drafts
a notification is accepted with no body
tools/list offers every tool in the registry
every advertised tool has a description and an object schema
a resource that does not exist is a protocol error, not a tool error
an unknown method is a protocol error
an unknown tool is an error RESULT, not a protocol error
a refused tool comes back as an error RESULT the model can read
an invalid config is refused as a result, not a crash
a non-object body is a parse error
a body with no method is an invalid request
